name: Fan-tailed Raven
rangeDescription: Sub-saharan africa, southern middle east, and arabian peninsula
description: This medium-sized all-dark crow has a unique batlike silhouette. When perched the tail seems normally-proportioned, but in flight it tail appears extremely short.

name: Obi Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Obi (northern moluccas)
description: A thrush-sized bird with a heavy bill, olive-green upperparts, and a yellow underside. Particularly note the yellow cheeks and the yellowish patch beside the bill, making the dark eye stand out from the face.

name: Bateleur
rangeDescription: Savanna and thornscrub of sub-saharan africa
description: A very distinctive, short-tailed eagle. Young birds are uniformly dark brown, and adults are mostly black with a bright red face and legs.

name: Sulawesi Brush Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region including banggai and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi) and buton and tukangbesi (to southeast)
description: A medium-sized cuckoo, with a warm buff colored throat, chest, and belly. Gray eyering and heavily barred tail.

name: Taiwan Bamboo-Partridge
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Medium-sized, mostly brownish terrestrial bird with a slate-gray head and neck, dark orange throat, and rusty spots on sides and wings. Endemic to Taiwan., where it inhabits lowland and foothill forests with undergrowth and densely vegetated edges, where difficult to see.

name: Neblina Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Central andes of peru (southern amazonas to huánuco)
description: Small tapaculo found only at very high elevations in the eastern Andes of Peru. Male is gray with black and brown barring on lower underparts and rump.

name: Philippine Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Philippines (luzon, catanduanes, and marinduque)
description: A medium-sized owl of lowland and foothill forest and edge. One of the largest scops-owls.

name: Green-tailed Bristlebill
rangeDescription: Guinea to sierra leone and ghana
description: An unusual and colorful rainforest bulbul. The upperparts are dark olive-green and the underparts yellow.

name: Prong-billed Barbet
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Strange brownish-yellow bird with thick silver bill and chunky body. Face and neck warm ochre; flanks silvery-gray.

name: Blue-bellied Roller
rangeDescription: Senegambia to central african republic, southern south sudan, and northeastern democratic republic of the congo
description: Chunky, distinctive, beautiful roller with long outer tail feathers. The body is mostly dark blue with a pale-gray hood.

name: Warbling Doradito
rangeDescription: Far southern brazil to eastern bolivia, uruguay, and eastern argentina
description: Small two-toned flycatcher, olive-brown above and yellow below. Note the rufescent crown patch.

name: Blue-and-white Mockingbird
rangeDescription: Humid highlands of southern mexico (chiapas) to western honduras
description: Skulking and heard far more often than seen, this fairly large and ample-tailed songbird replaces Blue Mockingbird in highlands and foothills south of Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Favors thickets, dense scrubby woodlands, and forest understory.

name: Copper Seedeater
rangeDescription: Eastern and central south america, from suriname and french guiana southward to southern brazil
description: Very small finchlike bird with a short bill. Males are unmistakable—mostly cinnamon with a black cap, wings, and tail.

name: Rennell Fantail
rangeDescription: Forest of rennell (southeastern solomon islands)
description: Mostly mouse-brown with a slightly paler throat and a russet wingbar. Long tail, often fanned, has pale fringes.

name: Doherty's Bushshrike
rangeDescription: Mountains of rwanda, burundi, western uganda, eastern democratic republic of the congo, and western kenya
description: Beautiful bird with an olive back, red throat and forehead, yellow belly, and black chest band. There is a rare morph in which the red is replaced with yellow.

name: Golden-breasted Puffleg
rangeDescription: Southwestern and central andes of colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: A fairly large hummingbird of high-elevation forest in the Andes in Colombia and Ecuador. Mostly green with an obvious golden sheen on the breast and white puffs on each leg.

name: Greater Sage-Grouse
rangeDescription: Prairies and sage grassland of western canada to southwestern usa
description: Large turkeylike bird found in extensive areas of sagebrush. Both sexes gray overall with very fine patterning, black belly, and long pointed tail.

name: Negros Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Philippines (panay and negros)
description: A fairly small owl of lowland and foothill forest on the islands of Negros and Panay, where it is the only scops-owl. Dark brown above and pale gray below, with a rufous face bordered with a black line and a pale gray V-shape between the eyes.

name: Terek Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Northern eurasia; winters to southern africa, southern asia, philippines, and northern australia
description: Unique smallish wader with stumpy bright orange legs and a noticeably upturned bill. Plumage gray overall with white belly, but in flight shows conspicuous white trailing edge to wings.

name: Cayenne Jay
rangeDescription: Southeastern venezuela (bolívar) to the guianas and northeastern brazil
description: Large jay of humid forest and edges including savanna and premontane forest in the tepui region. Combination of size and black-and-white plumage unlike any other species in range.
